replace_credentials.title: U-Tec credentials
replace_credentials.description: Community-maintained. Not made, endorsed, or supported by U-tec or Xthings. Uses each user's own OpenAPI credentials. Enter your Client ID and Client Secret from the Xthings app (My Account → OpenAPI). Submitting will start the U-Tec authorization. The Client Secret is never displayed back — re-enter it here even if you are only rotating the secret.

error.empty_credentials: Both Client ID and Client Secret are required.

init.title: U-Tec options
init.description: Community-maintained. Not made, endorsed, or supported by U-tec or Xthings. Uses each user's own OpenAPI credentials. Everyone using this integration shares U-tec's API, so please keep polling light.

update_push.title: Configure Uhome
update_push.description: Enable or disable push notifications for device updates

push_device_selection.title: Select Devices for Push Updates
push_device_selection.description: Choose which devices should receive push updates. If none are selected, all devices will receive updates.

device_selection.title: Select Active Devices
device_selection.description: Choose which devices should be active in HomeAssistant.

optimistic_updates.title: Optimistic Updates
optimistic_updates.description: Pick how each device type should reflect commands. 'All' writes optimistic state for every device of that type, 'None' waits for confirmed state, 'Custom' lets you pick specific devices.

pick_lights.title: Optimistic Lights
pick_lights.description: Select the light devices that should use optimistic updates. Unselected lights will wait for confirmed state.

pick_switches.title: Optimistic Switches
pick_switches.description: Select the switch devices that should use optimistic updates. Unselected switches will wait for confirmed state.

pick_locks.title: Optimistic Locks
pick_locks.description: Select the lock devices that should use optimistic updates. Unselected locks will wait for confirmed state.

polling_interval.title: Polling Interval
polling_interval.description: Minimum 10 seconds. Everyone using this integration shares U-tec's API, which has no published limits. Please use the longest interval that works for you; for quick lock confirmation, enable Adaptive Aggressive instead. 20 seconds is a good lock interval with Adaptive Aggressive on, and with reliable push you can go to 300 to 600 seconds. For a short 1-second test, use the Start debug polling button on the U-Tec Integration device.

adaptive_aggressive.title: Adaptive Aggressive
adaptive_aggressive.description: After a lock or unlock command, poll only that lock until the API reports the commanded state: four quick checks 1 second apart, then 2, 3, 5, 8 and 13 seconds (at most 9 polls, about 35 seconds). Recommended on. U-Tec push often never arrives, and this short burst is much lighter on the shared API than a fast poll interval. It stops as soon as the state is confirmed, when the next delay would be at least the idle poll interval, or when polls keep failing. Passage mode is skipped.

pick_adaptive_locks.title: Adaptive Aggressive Locks
pick_adaptive_locks.description: Select the locks that should get a confirmation burst after a command. Unselected locks wait for the idle poll or a push.

aa_avg_seconds_to_detect.name: Adaptive Aggressive average time to detect

aa_avg_polls_to_detect.name: Adaptive Aggressive average polls to detect

aa_ended_by_push.name: Adaptive Aggressive bursts ended by push

aa_ended_by_failures.name: Adaptive Aggressive bursts ended by failures

aa_exhausted.name: Adaptive Aggressive bursts that ran out

start_debug_polling.name: Start debug polling
start_debug_polling.description: Poll the U-Tec API every second for 2 minutes, then return to the configured interval. Adaptive Aggressive, push state and optimistic updates are paused so you see raw polled state. Calling it again while a session is running does not extend it.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: U-Tec config entry to debug. Leave empty for all loaded entries.

stop_debug_polling.name: Stop debug polling
stop_debug_polling.description: End a debug polling session early and return to the configured interval.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: U-Tec config entry to stop. Leave empty for all loaded entries.
